versions.changelog:
- Expanded coverage to global deals, adding sources from North America, Europe, Asia Pacific, and gaming/virtual product sites.
- Updated output structure to include more detailed fields (title, description, price, discount/heat/match reason, url) for each result.
- Increased safety and compliance features, including API friendliness and form submission restrictions.
- Support for new intents like refreshing deal picks, showing more deals, and finding gaming deals.
- Renamed skill to ToMe Global Deals to reflect broader focus.

- Initial release of ToMe Daily Deals.
- Curates three trusted public deals from major deal sites.
- Deal categories: Best Savings, Trending Now, and For You (personalized).
- Read-only, public info only, and privacy-conscious (no login or personal data).
